instruction: Use FreeCADCmd or a FreeCAD Python automation workflow with the Path/CAM modules. Read the initial file(s) from the Desktop path(s): /home/user/Desktop/part.step, /home/user/Desktop/fixture.step. Use the fixture as check geometry in FreeCAD Path/CAM. While machining the top pocket, every low-level toolpath point must keep at least 3 mm clearance from the fixture. Tool definition: T1 is an end mill for the top pocket while respecting fixture clearance. Write the required output file(s) to the output folder using exactly these absolute file paths: /home/user/Desktop/task-30.nc.
